references.text: Esau settled in the Seir mountains, confirming that his descendants took over this area
The Horites are mentioned as the original inhabitants of Seir before Esau's descendants displaced them
The Horites in the Seir mountains are mentioned as a people who lived in the area
Repeats how the Lord helped Esau's descendants drive out the Horites from Seir
The Lord gave the Seir mountains to Esau's descendants as an inheritance
Confirms that Jacob and Esau separated, and Esau went to the Seir mountains
Israel took possession of land in a similar way as Esau's descendants did with the Horites
Describes how the Lord intended to drive out the peoples before Israel, just as he did for Esau's children
Obadiah prophesies about Edom/Esau's descendants and their dwelling place in Seir
